svg.aria-label: Dataset: 9.45 million US patents granted 1976 to 2025, four PatentsView tables, 123 deep-tech fields kept; 15.5 GB of raw tables reduced to a 3.9 MB Relate file. Licence CC BY 4.0. No individual patent is stored. The line shows how patenting in these fields grew each year.
